title: DB connection leak — no try/finally in FastAPI routes
recommended_action: Wrap route bodies in contextlib.closing(_conn()) or a yield/close FastAPI dependency

title: create_entity INSERT causes 500 on duplicate id
recommended_action: Use INSERT OR REPLACE (upsert) or catch IntegrityError and return 409

title: Unvalidated request bodies return 500 not 400
recommended_action: Guard await request.json() and validate shape with Pydantic models; 400 on bad input

title: SQLite concurrency race on data/hub.db (no WAL/busy_timeout)
recommended_action: Enable PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and busy_timeout on both connections; chunk ingest commits

title: DDL drift risk — duplicated inline schema unguarded
recommended_action: Single-source DDL module imported by both; add PRAGMA user_version; extend freeze test to DDL

title: Unbounded/negative limit
recommended_action: Constrain limit with Query(500 ge=1 le=N) and validate body limit

title: manifest.py has no error handling
recommended_action: Catch FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError and return friendly INVALID like validate.py

title: fetch_all no per-producer error isolation
recommended_action: Wrap each producer iteration in try/except; record per-producer error; continue; guard cmd isinstance str

title: Startup/registry-shape crashes
recommended_action: Validate registry shape (program_id present; producers is a list; hub/schema_version keys)

title: Non-atomic file writes cause reader races
recommended_action: Write temp file + os.replace(); tolerate a bad JSONL line

title: rstrip('s') plural gotcha
recommended_action: Strip single trailing s (name[:-1] if endswith s) or explicit singular map

title: Unauth mutation API reachable via 0.0.0.0 Docker bind
recommended_action: Bind compose to 127.0.0.1:8000; document no-auth-never-past-loopback invariant; gate mutations behind auth/read-only flag

title: No body-size limits / unbounded prefetch (DoS)
recommended_action: Proxy/uvicorn body cap; clamp limit/max_hits; cap bulk_create item count

title: Error details reflect caller ids
recommended_action: Generic 404 detail; keep specifics in server logs

title: Spatial-RAG donor undeclared deps
recommended_action: Add pinned tenacity geoalchemy2 pgvector numpy; drop dead sse-starlette pin (donor only)

title: mypy python_version 3.10 vs requires-python >=3.9
recommended_action: Set mypy python_version=3.9 or raise floor to 3.10

title: Sub-package floor inconsistency (>=3.10 vs >=3.9)
recommended_action: Unify to 3.10 or document the matrix explicitly

title: No pip-audit/npm-audit/security scan/coverage/Dependabot
recommended_action: Add pip-audit + npm audit job; coverage gate; dependabot.yml

title: Lint/type coverage narrow (src/hub+tests only)
recommended_action: Widen ruff/mypy to tools/ server/backend/ desktop/

title: Mixed/duplicated pinning; server deps unpinned in image
recommended_action: Pick one pinning strategy; de-duplicate vs server extra; consume lockfile in Dockerfile

title: Deprecated starlette.testclient in 3 test files
recommended_action: Standardize on fastapi.testclient

title: Ruff ruleset minimal
recommended_action: Add I and B rules; hold UP until Python floor is 3.10+

title: mypy leniency (global ignore_missing_imports)
recommended_action: Scope ignores via per-module overrides; add types-jsonschema

title: Node engines not enforced in package.json
recommended_action: Add engines node >=22

title: Frontend major upgrades (React 18->19 etc)
recommended_action: Separate initiative; not part of HOLD-safe pass

title: SQLite migration+versioning; single-source DDL
recommended_action: See BUG-5; ADR is HOLD-safe now

title: Pin server deps / use lockfile in image
recommended_action: Ship pinned server deps aligning with Phase-0 freeze artifacts

title: Structured logging + request-ID middleware + error tracking
recommended_action: ASGI middleware for X-Request-ID + JSON access log; env-gated error sink

title: CLI --version
recommended_action: argparse action=version from package metadata

title: Extend schema-freeze to DDL/registry + hub doctor
recommended_action: Freeze registry/DDL boundaries; optional hub doctor config-validation command

title: Ingest snapshot-metadata scaffold
recommended_action: Persist ingest-snapshot record (source dir counts timestamp producer SHAs)
